capabilities: Schedule checkbox tasks by dragging them onto day, week, month and year calendars
Plan date spans in Gantt and resource-timeline views and on a Kanban board
Set due dates and inclusive deadlines and find overdue tasks
Create daily, weekly, monthly or yearly repeating tasks
Edit task wording, subtasks, priorities and colors in place
disambiguation: Not only for recurring tasks; repetition is one feature of a broader calendar-based task planner.
extras: README discloses that the plugin enumerates vault file paths and explains community scanner status messages; notes that earlier-version project links and task lists were removed in 0.5.0 with legacy data kept in data.json as a reversible backup; requires Obsidian 1.7.2+.
problem: Obsidian tasks are plain checkboxes inside notes, with no visual calendar to schedule them, track deadlines or spot overdue work.

relations.evidence: The second requires the core Daily notes plugin

summary: Task planner that turns Markdown checkbox tasks into drag-and-drop calendars, timelines, Gantt charts, a Kanban board and a daily agenda.
